digest.component_or_area: outbound mapper and backend adapters (rebar reconciler)
propositions: Outbound mapper receives assignee resolver via attribute injection rather than constructor parameter, causing silent degradation when injection fails and hiding the dependency from type checking

Attribute injection pattern led to dead code in Data Center adapter PR #120 where getattr discovery was present but nothing ever set the attribute, resulting in permanently non-authoritative assignee resolution
Two distinct resolver lifecycles (core per-issue and DC per-client) require explicit precedence semantics that attribute injection obscures and explicit parameters would make visible
Resolver must be threaded through compute_update_fields to diff_canonical_fields to resolve_assignee call site, but current injection only occurs at compute_update_fields entry
Neutral backend contract OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee lacks a declared resolver parameter, making the dependency invisible to type checkers and forcing type: ignore comments
